entries.label: Strength
entries.detail: +1 ancestry, +1 background, +1 class key attribute, +1 free boost

entries.label: Armor Class
entries.detail: 10 + 1 Dex (cap +2) + 3 Scale Mail + 3 trained armor prof

entries.label: Fist
entries.detail: 5 expert + 4 Str · agile, finesse, nonlethal, unarmed

entries.label: Dagger
entries.detail: 5 expert (simple) + 4 Str · thrown 10 ft. · agile, finesse, thrown 10 ft., versatile S

entries.label: Darkvision
entries.detail: You can see in darkness and dim light just as well as you can see in bright light, though your vision in darkness is in black and white.

entries.label: Clan Dagger
entries.detail: You get one clan dagger of your clan for free, as it was given to you at birth. Selling this dagger is considered a terrible taboo.

entries.label: Rock Dwarf
entries.detail: Your feet are firmly planted. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to Reposition, Shove, or Trip you, and to saving throws against spells or effects that would force you to move or knock you prone. If any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you are moved only half the distance.

entries.label: Rock Runner
entries.detail: Your feet are sure on stone. You ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble and uneven ground made of stone and earth. You aren't off-guard while Balancing on narrow surfaces of stone and earth, and successes on Acrobatics checks to Balance there become critical successes.

entries.label: Reactive Strike
entries.detail: Reaction. Trigger: a creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to it.

entries.label: Shield Block
entries.detail: General feat (granted). Reaction. Trigger: while you have your shield raised, you would take physical damage from an attack. Your shield prevents damage up to its Hardness; you and the shield each take any remaining damage.

entries.label: Sudden Charge
entries.detail: With a quick sprint, you dash up to your foe and swing: Stride twice, and if you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, make a melee Strike against that enemy. You can use Sudden Charge while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

entries.label: Intimidating Glare
entries.detail: You lived your life by the sword, either as a mercenary or a warrior defending your people.

entries.label: Coins
entries.detail: 15 gp starting wealth - 8 gp, 8 sp spent
